# Processes

The commands `mt help` lists under Processes. Runs are known as processes in Maitento. More in [Runs and events](../../../concepts/runs-and-events.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`kill`](#kill) | Kill a live run, by its type and id (final: the run ends as Killed and cannot be resumed) |
| [`process-list`](#process-list) | List runs of every type, live and ended, newest first (of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`) |
| [`process-summary`](#process-summary) | Show an overview of a namespace's recent runs: counts by type and state, live runs, recent failures and tokens used |
| [`ps`](#ps) | List the live runs of every type in a namespace (apps, interactions, capsules and code pipelines) |
| [`retention-get`](#retention-get) | Show how long the tenant's runs are kept after they end, and how many runs it retains against its limit |
| [`run-release`](#run-release) | Release a run kept with run-retain, and the runs it kept, so the tenant's retention applies again |
| [`run-retain`](#run-retain) | Keep a run, and every run it started, past the tenant's retention until you release it (for at most your plan's longest retention) |

## kill

Kill a live run, by its type and id (final: the run ends as Killed and cannot be resumed).

```text
mt kill [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type, -t <App\|Interaction\|Capsule\|CodePipeline>` | one of `App`, `Interaction`, `Capsule`, `CodePipeline` | yes |  | The run's type: App, Interaction, Capsule or CodePipeline |
| `--id, -i <id>` | id | yes |  | The run's id |

## process-list

List runs of every type, live and ended, newest first (of the namespace; every namespace with `--all`).

```text
mt process-list [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--all, -a` | flag |  |  | List the runs of every namespace |
| `--type, -t <value>` | text |  |  | Only these types, comma-separated: App, Interaction, Capsule, CodePipeline |
| `--state, -s <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs in this state: active (queued or running), waiting (on a person, an approval or a resume) or terminal (ended) |
| `--status <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs with these statuses, comma-separated: each type's own status names (e.g. Running,PendingApproval) |
| `--definition-id <id>` | id |  |  | Only runs of this interaction, app, capsule or code pipeline (its id) |
| `--root <id>` | id |  |  | Only runs in this run's tree (the root run's id) |
| `--parent <id>` | id |  |  | Only runs this run started directly (its id) |
| `--retained` | flag |  |  | Only runs kept by run-retain, directly or through a retained run above them |
| `--since <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs created at or after this time: ISO 8601, UTC unless an offset is given (e.g. 2026-10-24T09:00Z) |
| `--before <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs created before this time: ISO 8601, UTC unless an offset is given |
| `--limit, -l <number>` | whole number |  | `50` | Maximum number of runs to list (1-200) |
| `--cursor <value>` | text |  |  | The cursor a previous page printed, for the next page |

## process-summary

Show an overview of a namespace's recent runs: counts by type and state, live runs, recent failures and tokens used.

```text
mt process-summary [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--hours <number>` | whole number |  |  | How many hours back to look, 1-168 (default: 48) |
| `--all, -a` | flag |  |  | Cover every namespace instead of one |

## ps

List the live runs of every type in a namespace (apps, interactions, capsules and code pipelines).

```text
mt ps [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## retention-get

Show how long the tenant's runs are kept after they end, and how many runs it retains against its limit.

```text
mt retention-get
```

## run-release

Release a run kept with run-retain, and the runs it kept, so the tenant's retention applies again.

```text
mt run-release <type> <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<type>` | one of `App`, `Interaction`, `Capsule`, `CodePipeline` | yes |  | The run's type: App, Interaction, Capsule or CodePipeline |
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The run's id |

## run-retain

Keep a run, and every run it started, past the tenant's retention until you release it (for at most your plan's longest retention).

```text
mt run-retain <type> <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<type>` | one of `App`, `Interaction`, `Capsule`, `CodePipeline` | yes |  | The run's type: App, Interaction, Capsule or CodePipeline |
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The run's id |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--note, -n <value>` | text |  |  | Why it is kept (at most 500 characters) |
